payload.title: File:Gorgonavis alcyone (holotype, reconstructed skull bones).jpg
payload.artist_html: S. M. Nebreda, L. M. Chiappe, G. Navalón, J. C. Terol, F. J. Serrano, Á. D. Buscalioni, J. Marugán-Lobón
payload.credit_html: "An isolated skull from Las Hoyas (Early Cretaceous, Spain) informs the early evolution towards elongated rostra in enantiornithine birds (Aves, Ornithothoraces)"
payload.description_html: Digital reconstruction of the cranial bones of Gorgonavis alcyone (MUPA-LH-13240). A. Skull reconstruction based on preserved bones in anatomical position, in lateral view, based on preserved bones; B. Jugal; C. Quadrate; D. Lacrimal; E. Parietal; F. Postdentary; G. Dentary. Scale bar: 5 mm (B–G).
